---
title: Capability matrix
description: Which operations each forge supports.
icon: i-lucide-table
---

The table lists every capability for every provider. The GitHub column assumes app auth with an installation. With a token, `installations` is not available. The Tangled column assumes that `notificationsUrl` is set.

See [Capabilities](/concepts/capabilities) for the meaning of each level. Hover a cell for the verbs it covers, or open a [provider page](/providers) for one forge.
